## Podcast search like Spotify
- **Typing does not have to be exact:** accents and umlauts are forgiven ("äffchen mit kâffchen" finds "Äffchen mit Käffchen"), also "ae/oe/ue" for ä/ö/ü and no accents at all
- **Typos:** when nothing close turns up, the single words are searched and the shows that look most like what you typed come first
- **Best match first:** shows whose name matches your words are sorted to the top and become the top result
- **Shows only on Spotify:** with Spotify connected they appear in the search too. If such a show has a public feed it opens as a normal show, otherwise its page says it is only on Spotify and opens it there

## Install
- **Update server:** Settings → Updates → Update now (or run the Proxmox script)
- **Android / Windows / Linux:** nothing to install, the apps pick it up from the server
